description: Screenshot of a tweet by account 'VB Nationalist' (@vmbb12), labeled at top as retweeted by Donald J. Trump. The tweet urges supporters to 'fight back' and links a US news headline stating President Trump called on Fox News to 'bring back' Jeanine Pirro. The link preview shows side-by-side portrait photos of Jeanine Pirro smiling and Donald Trump. Engagement counts show 1.4K replies, 3.1K retweets, 10K likes.

description: Digital artwork of a single tree split down the middle into two states: the left half in vivid orange-red autumn foliage against a bright blue sky over green grass with small white flowers, the right half bare and leafless against a murky brown-yellow haze over darker ground. The split-tree composition reads as a contrast between life/vitality and death/decay, or changing seasons. No text or identifying marks are visible.

Photograph of a somewhat tattered United States flag on a flagpole, backlit by a low sun at sunset or sunrise over open water, with the sun's disc visible through the flag's stripes and reflected on the sea below. A visible moire/screen-door texture suggests this is a photo taken of a display screen or printed image. The original filename '1775.PNG' evokes the year of the American Revolution's start, a recurring Q-post motif; the location is not identifiable.
flags: Location and photographer unknown; filename '1775' is the only contextual clue

description: Photograph of a screen showing a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet reading 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN!' timestamped 7:04 PM, 17 Mar 2019, with 10,702 retweets and 42,077 likes. Below it is a reply from an account named 'QAnon' (@qanon76) exhorting 'patriots' to be proud and rise up 'like in 2016', attaching a photo of a backlit American flag at sunset over water (the same flag image archived as n=858). The original filename 'Hello, Jack' appears to address Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey; the @qanon76 account is a follower account, not verified as the Q poster.

description: Official government portrait of James R. Clapper, Director of National Intelligence (2010-2017), matching his DNI official photo (the manifest filename is 'James_R._Clapper_official_portrait.jpg'). Clapper, bald with glasses and a white goatee, wears a dark suit, white shirt, red patterned tie, and a lapel pin, posed in front of a U.S. flag and the blue seal of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence.
